column1: # The brotli 1.2.0 CLI's verdict (`brotli -d -c`: err, or ok:<length>:<the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256>) on each
# mutation of a recorded stream, recorded 2026-10-24: cut:<n> keeps the first n bytes,
# tail:<hex> appends that byte, flip:<bit> flips bit (bit % 8) of byte (bit / 8). Every cut
# of five streams, 40 seeded cuts and one trailing byte of each other, 300 seeded flips of ten.
